name: Aishah binti Rahman
bio: Aishah is a socialite who enjoys the finer things in life, thanks to her family's successful import-export business. While she's never held a traditional job, she's a fixture in the Malaysian racing scene, attending events and cultivating friendships with drivers and team owners alike. Aishah is fiercely independent and values her freedom, so she's not looking for anything too serious. She enjoys excitement and spontaneity, and seeks a partner who can keep up with her fast-paced lifestyle. For her, life is about living in the moment.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in loose braids or a high ponytail
physical.description: Aishah has a striking presence, accentuated by her bold fashion sense. She has a slender build and a radiant smile that often makes her the center of attention.

meetingContext: At a VIP lounge during the Malaysian Grand Prix
firstImpression: She's laughing loudly with a group of drivers, radiating confidence and effortless style.
loveLanguage: Gifts - she appreciates thoughtful, luxurious gestures that show you pay attention to her tastes.
